runs.failure_point: It found all three qualifying matters but also counted a scoping-stage engagement, with only a status caveat.

first_error.why: The answer counts an engagement whose scoping memo it read at [32]-[61] as a qualifying investigation, adding only a status caveat.

divergence: All three runs failed precision the same way: each counted a scoping-stage audit-committee engagement as a qualifying investigation, and the critic named that inclusion in T1 and T2 without the agent dropping it. The runs split on the third matter. T0's file-name search was capped at 240 lines after a timed-out scan, so that matter never surfaced (search miss; the critic named the cap and the unopened matter); T0 also ran out of context right after writing. T1 found and read the matter but excluded it as not board-directed, a judgement the critic called weak (under-inclusion). T2 used an uncapped file-name pass, read the matter's report and included it (3/4).
